_comment: Patch these blocks into the mediczy-app container definition and task def volumes array.
_instructions: 1. Merge 'containerPatch' into the mediczy-app container definition (healthCheck + mountPoints).
2. Replace REPLACE_WITH_EFS_ID with the actual EFS filesystem ID from setup-autoscaling-efs.sh output.
3. Add the 'volumes' array to the top-level task definition JSON.
4. Re-register: aws ecs register-task-definition --cli-input-json file://app-task-def-full.json --region ap-south-1
5. Force redeploy: aws ecs update-service --cluster control-plane-cluster --service mediczy-app --task-definition mediczy-app:<new-rev> --force-new-deployment --region ap-south-1
6. Apply ecs/livekit-cloud-task-def-patch.json to the same mediczy-app container so prod tokens point to LiveKit Cloud.
